title: Tired of sweet protein shakes in the morning - need savory 25g+ quick options
content: SIMULATED DATA [Think9 Pulse Demo]: Every high protein breakfast idea online is sweet - whey shakes, protein oats, sweet pancakes. I get nauseous drinking 30g sweet vanilla powder at 7am. Why is nobody making a quick, microwaveable 25g savory protein square with real eggs and herbs that doesn't taste like rubber?
